title: AuthUi::proxy_list_open bool is the sign-in proxy box's open stage, reset by hand in follow_auth(Ready) and close_proxy_list_box
trigger: Open the proxy list from the sign-in screen (pane Connecting), then the account reaches Ready; or the flag is left true while pane_mode flips Connecting -> Ready -> Connecting
effect: No bug today: proxy_list_box_shown() also gates on pane_mode()==Connecting and follow_auth clears the flag on Ready, but the box stage is a bool plus a derived pane check kept in step by hand
fix: fold into the existing DialogKind box host (open_box/close) or an enum on AuthUi (Closed/ProxyList) cleared by the Farewell/auth transition in one place

title: Capture holds three two-variant enums (RecordMode Held/Locked, DiscardRow Hidden/Confirming, Delivery Normal/PlayOnce) that are bools renamed
trigger: Record a voice message, press Lock, Play once and Cancel (discard row) in any order
effect: No bug today: each is an independent user toggle read and written through RecordingUi setters and dropped with the Capture, but DiscardRow::Confirming is a confirm sub-stage of RecordStage::Recording kept beside it, set by request_discard_recording and cleared by hand in 'keep-recording' and nowhere else
fix: fold the confirm into the recording's stage (RecordStage::Recording{ confirm_discard }) or keep the toggles as one small struct of user options; DiscardRow alone should be an Option-free sub-variant of the recording stage

title: ProxyEditor keeps error: Option<String> beside save: ProxySave; the two are changed together by hand
trigger: Press Save with a bad server (error set, save Editing), fix the field and Save again (error cleared, save Saving(request)); or a refused save (proxy_saving_upkeep sets save Editing and error together)
effect: No bug today: every writer (save_proxy_editor, proxy_saving_upkeep, the kind radio) sets both, but a refusal is 'Editing plus an error' rather than its own stage, so a writer that sets one and forgets the other would show a stale error or hide a refusal
fix: ProxySave::{Editing{error: Option<String>}, Saving(RequestId)} (or Failed(String)) so the error leaves with the stage

title: PickerUi::poll_pick (PollPick::Sticker/Emoji(slot)) names a slot of the poll box in ChatUi but is cleared by hand from four places, not with the box
trigger: Choose Sticker or the smiley on a poll option, then cancel the poll box while the sticker panel stays open
effect: No visible bug: close_poll_dialog does not clear poll_pick; the next sticker or emoji pick finds no slot (target_of_attach is None), clears it and falls back to sending to the chat. The pick is stage state of the poll box held by another owner and healed lazily
fix: hold the pending pick inside PollDialog (its owner) so closing the box drops it, and have the panel ask the dialog instead of a second owner
